channel.title: Prism Inspector
channel.description: Updates for Prism Inspector, the macOS companion for PrismKit.

item.description:
New

  • Update notes now describe what changed for you, instead of listing internal commits.
  • Design checks now hold up across devices. A design frame can now say whether its coordinates are measured from the safe area or from the screen, so the same design is checked correctly on a phone with a Dynamic Island, one with a notch, and one with neither — instead of reporting every element as misplaced. When a screen genuinely is offset, that is one finding that explains itself rather than one per element. And naming a view no longer stops the check from noticing that its wording drifted.

Fixed

  • The AI agent integration now works on Intel Macs. The app was already universal, but the MCP server bundled inside it was built for Apple silicon only — so on an Intel Mac the app opened normally while an agent could never connect.

Nothing else changes how the app behaves: the rest is packaging.

First public release

  • Inspect and measure a SwiftUI app running in the iOS Simulator — click to select, ⌥-click to measure between elements.
  • Spacing flagged when it falls off your design system's scale.
  • Check the screen against a design and get what moved, what is the wrong size, and what is missing.
  • Play the screen back the way VoiceOver reads it.
  • An MCP server inside the app, so an AI agent can read the same measurements.
